title: Live Trading: Garbage Trades from Aggressive Copy-Trade Defaults

user_feedback.comments: Bot trading away real money erratically. $25 random buys. Analytics wrong. Balances not detected correctly. Need real metrics and real copycat trading.

what_happened.task: Bot in MODE=live with real private keys executing trades on Base ($483), ETH ($246), Arbitrum ($45), BSC ($197 BNB)
symptoms: Bot making $25 garbage copy trades on single-wallet signals with no confirmed buy size
Balance checks returning 0.0 due to RPC case-sensitivity (lowercase address vs EIP-55 checksum)
TIER2_COUNT was set to 1 in wallet_monitor.py local defaults, overriding the safe setting in settings.py
DEFAULT_COPY_USD=$25 fired for ALL Streams events (which never include USD values)
MIN_BUY_USD=50 meant any $50 alpha buy triggered a copy (noise, not conviction)

root_causes.primary: wallet_monitor.py local constants overrode settings.py values with dangerously aggressive defaults (TIER2_COUNT=1, DEFAULT_COPY_USD=25, MIN_BUY_USD=50)
root_causes.secondary: _get_evm_balance sent lowercase addresses to JSON-RPC — some RPCs require EIP-55 checksum format, returning 0x0 for non-checksummed input
root_causes.tertiary: Moralis Streams events never include buy_value_usd — code should SKIP not DEFAULT to $25

wallet_monitor.py: TIER1_COUNT: 2 → 3 (require 3 alpha wallets for instant execute)
TIER2_COUNT: 1 → 2 (require 2 wallets for express lane — not just 1)
MAX_BUY_AGE_SECONDS: 300 → 120 (stale = miss, 5min window was too wide)
DEFAULT_COPY_USD: 25 → 0 (skip Streams events with no confirmed USD)
COPY_SIZE_PCT: 0.30 → 0.05 (5% of OUR wallet balance, not 30% of alpha buy)
MAX_COPY_USD: 100 → 250 (raise cap to match real capital)
_execute_copy_trade: added 3-gate validation (confirmed value, min size, wallet balance-based sizing)
config/settings.py: Aligned all WALLET_MONITOR_* defaults to match wallet_monitor.py fixes
core/wallet_router.py: _get_evm_balance: add Web3.to_checksum_address() normalization before RPC call
_get_evm_balance: add 2-attempt retry with 1s backoff per RPC endpoint
_get_evm_balance: check for RPC-level 'error' field (rate limits return error not 0x0)

critical_rules_extracted: NEVER use DEFAULT_COPY_USD > 0. Streams events have no USD. Default fires unbounded garbage.
ALWAYS checksum EVM addresses before sending to JSON-RPC (Web3.to_checksum_address)
TIER counts must be in settings.py AND wallet_monitor.py local defaults must match
Copy trade size = % of OUR balance, NOT % of alpha's buy (alpha may have 100x our capital)
MIN_BUY_USD >= $500: below this is noise from small wallets, not smart money conviction
